title: Anime Styles in AI Video: Prompts and Real Examples
summary: Compare 4 anime styles in AI video with real moving clips and copyable prompts: retro cel, soft pastoral, painted donghua and rainy city.
body_markdown:
### What are the different anime art styles?


Common anime art styles include retro cel with ink outlines and flat colour, soft painted pastoral and painterly rainy city scenes. Terms such as shonen, shojo and seinen describe the audience for a series rather than one way of drawing it.


### What makes something look like anime?


Anime is known for limited animation, flat expression, large eyes and colourful, exaggerated hair, though[Wikipedia's anime article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anime) notes a wide variety of art styles and no single dominant one. In an AI prompt, try words such as cel shading, ink outlines and a limited palette to ask for this look.


### What is the 1990s anime style?


The 1990s anime style usually means hand-painted cels: visible ink outlines, flat shading, a muted palette and some film grain. The Flick[1990s anime page](https://flick.art/tools/90s-anime) is built around this look, and the words to try in a prompt are cel shading, muted palette and grain.


### Can AI make a Ghibli style video?


AI video can make the soft painted look people call Ghibli style, using a painted start frame, watercolour fields and a still camera. Describe the look rather than copying a film, since Studio Ghibli's films and characters belong to the studio.


### What is the difference between anime and donghua?


Anime is animation from Japan and donghua is animation from China, and the two share many drawing conventions such as cel shading and painted backgrounds. A prompt can name either one as a style word, then describe the line, colour and setting you want.


### Which AI video models work for anime styles?


Flick filmmakers have made anime style clips with Seedance 2.0, Seedance 2.5, Seedance Pro and Kling O3 Pro, all on the Standard plan ($20 a month). You can try the same approach on a free account with MiniMax H3 Max, using 100 credits you get when you sign up.
